description: Utility functions for GraphQL field extraction, validation, serialization, and change detection in a React-based admin UI project.

methods.name: extractRootFields
methods.description: Recursively extracts root field names from a GraphQL selection set.

methods.name: getRootGraphQLFieldsFromFieldController
methods.description: Generates a list of root GraphQL fields from a FieldController's selection.

methods.name: useInvalidFields
methods.description: Determines which fields are invalid based on validation functions and filters.

methods.name: makeDefaultValueState
methods.description: Creates a default state object for fields based on their default values.

methods.name: deserializeItemToValue
methods.description: Deserializes a raw item into a structured value object based on field controllers.

methods.name: serializeValueToOperationItem
methods.description: Serializes a value object into an operation-specific GraphQL input, considering required fields.

methods.name: useHasChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are unsaved changes between current values and reference values.
